# Clover Pet & House Sitting

> Professional in-home pet sitting and house sitting in Frome and across Somerset and Wiltshire, UK. Run by Monika Janalikova — registered, fully insured, DBS-checked, with 8+ years of experience and 50+ five-star reviews and references.

Clover Pet & House Sitting offers a single service: overnight, in-home pet sitting / house sitting. The sitter stays at the owner's home so pets keep their own routine, bed and garden — no boarding, no kennels. Daily photo or video updates are sent on every booking. Bookings are made directly with Monika (not through a third-party pet-sitting marketplace).

## Key facts

- 8+ years of professional pet and house sitting experience
- 50+ five-star reviews and references, including verified reviews of completed sittings
- Registered, holds Pet Business Insurance, clean and up-to-date DBS (background) check
- Experienced in medication administration when agreed in advance
- Experience with senior dogs and special-needs animals
- Cares for dogs, cats and small pets of all sizes
- Booking process: enquiry → video call and, where possible, an in-person meet & greet → invoice and payment by bank transfer → confirmed sit
- Cancellations more than 7 days before the start date are fully refunded; 7 days or less are non-refundable
- Does not drive — travels to sittings by train or bus, so covers areas reachable by public transport from Frome

## Service area

Based in Frome, Somerset. Covers Frome, Trowbridge, Westbury, Warminster, Salisbury, Chippenham, Melksham, Shepton Mallet, Castle Cary and other public-transport-accessible locations across Somerset and Wiltshire.
